title: Exact Differential Bounds for Seven and Eight Rounds of Alzette
summary: For Alzette's seven- and eight-round cases, exhaustive search established upper bounds, but computational limits leave the exact maxima and tightness unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For seven and eight rounds of Alzette, determine the exact maximum expected differential characteristic probabilities over valid differential trails, equivalently the tight differential bounds. Exhaustive search established upper bounds of $2^{-24}$ and $2^{-32}$ for seven and eight rounds, respectively, but did not terminate in reasonable time and therefore did not determine whether these bounds are tight.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of the 64-bit Alzette ARX-box.
parameters: Seven rounds: the first target round count
Eight rounds: the second target round count
Valid differential trails: the admissible trails over which the maximum is taken
Expected differential characteristic probability: the quantity to maximize
2^-24 and 2^-32: established upper bounds for seven and eight rounds, respectively
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the exact maximum expected differential characteristic probabilities for seven and eight rounds and establish whether the respective upper bounds are tight.

citations.label: Alzette: a 64-bit ARX-box (feat. CRAX and TRAX)

progress.summary: The source reports that its search produced maximum-probability trails through six rounds but did not terminate in reasonable time for seven or eight rounds. Exhaustive search established upper bounds for those cases, leaving their tightness unresolved.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., Alzette: a 64-bit ARX-box (feat. CRAX and TRAX)
